tasks.description: Capture supplier invoices and code them to the ledger.
tasks.tryThisWeek: Batch ten invoices through your ERP’s capture feature and log every field you had to correct.

tasks.name: Bank reconciliation
tasks.description: Match bank lines to ledger entries and clear differences.
tasks.tryThisWeek: Write matching rules for your three most common transaction types and test them on last month.

tasks.name: Exception handling
tasks.description: Investigate mismatches, duplicates, and policy breaches.
tasks.tryThisWeek: Keep a short log of each exception and the judgment call you made. Patterns become playbooks.

tasks.name: Month-end reporting
tasks.description: Prepare month-end packs and variance commentary.
tasks.tryThisWeek: Ask an AI assistant to draft variance commentary, then edit it and note what it missed.

tasks.name: Client communication
tasks.description: Resolve payment queries with vendors and internal teams.
tasks.tryThisWeek: Draft three reusable reply templates for common payment queries and personalise each one.

tasks.name: Expense claim review
tasks.description: Check claims against policy and approve or return them.
tasks.tryThisWeek: Turn your expense policy into a checklist an AI tool can pre-screen against, then spot-check results.
